{{Top}}
[[File:MillenniumFalcon-SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|Sublight [[Engine/Legends|engines]] on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]]]
A '''sublight engine''', also called a '''sublight drive''', was a vital [[Starship/Legends|starship]] component used to drive ships through [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] at speeds less than the speed of light; the most common form of sublight drive was the [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]], which the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] used two of to achieve its incredible speeds.

The usual speeds achieved by sublight drive were quite substantial, amounting to a respectable fraction of the speed of light. A [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]-sized vessel propelled by sublight drive could clear the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and its [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] in a matter of minutes.

The [[Hoersch-Kessel ion drive|most common sublight drive]] was produced by [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]], and found in vessels ranging from the [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]. [[Durafly]] also produced sublight drives.
